Manuel stood proudly on the lush green grass of Old Trafford, taking in the sheer magnitude of his new home. The €50m move from Paris was officially complete, sealing his fate for the next five years. At 23 years old, the young Uruguayan midfielder felt a surge of ambition coursing through his veins. Erik ten Hag walked over, offering a firm handshake. The manager knew that pairing Manuel with Casemiro would create an impenetrable shield in the midfield. 

Dan Ashworth grinned from the sidelines, relieved that their primary target had finally arrived in Manchester to help the squad win trophies. Manuel gazed around the empty stadium, imagining the deafening cheers of the crowd, ready to give absolutely everything for the club's success. He wrapped up his media interview and looked directly into the cameras. 

Any other questions?
